title: Cost and Hour Report (FlexFile)
issuerPreparingActivity: OSD Cost Assessment and Program Evaluation (CAPE)
releaseStatement: A per official ASSIST revision-history Distribution Statement column
notes: Official ASSIST verified Active base dated 2017-11-15 on 2026-11-06. The A in the history row is a distribution statement, not revision A. Fresh complete local source opened: packet/halcyon-batch-5/_work/DI-FNCL-82162.pdf (14 pages). All pages text-inspected; applicable pages 2 and 6 rendered and visually inspected. No indexed summaries used. Extraction covers WBS dictionary content and applicable format/delivery/marking, not numeric cost/hour datasets. Requirements 2 prints Data Groups A through H while enumerating A-G; source wording is preserved. The prior CWBS Dictionary format prohibition applies within the invoked FlexFile path, not as a universal repeal of the standalone DID. Contract-specified alternative format remains permitted. Data Group A.12 uses should for unclassified-only submission; no universal shall prohibition is fabricated. DD Form 2794 is a referenced planning input, not an inspected or invented completed form. FlexFile Implementation Guide content was not inspected or extracted.
